Chapter 1: Temple of the Purple Flame

Deep in the diseased Magna Woods squats Korash-Bal, the Temple of the Purple Flame — a demon fane from Sathmog's reign, its walls painted with violet fire and choked with man-eating briars. A portal to the demon prince's realm has cracked open in its undercroft, warping plants and beasts alike: a monstrous manticore now prowls the vaulted hall and giant spiders stalk the halls. A band of Sathmog cultists came hunting lost relics; three stepped through the portal, two came back horribly twisted, and the rest are fleeing in terror. The heroes may find an old elf tending herbs, the bone mask hidden in the altar, and the restless dead of the sacrificial pit. Victory means looting the temple, braving the demonic realm for the statuette piece, and closing the portal by quenching the violet flame.

12 scenes · 7 stat blocks · 2 maps · 7 treasure
